text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, I have an official announcement!
I'm going to take on the BC~!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Whew!" "Insane" "So hyped"
"It was in the online news" "Way too emotional"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Looks like everyone's already caught the news!
That's right, it's officially decided that I'm joining
the BC expedition team, "DREAMS"!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "It depends on how hard we work going forward, but our major goal will be the BC!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, today is a special BC project~!
Let's watch past race footage together!
(WOOOAAAH)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, the pace is so fast...!
This is what the world stage feels like~!

Footage of a race of extraordinary caliber...
As she watches it intently, she looks overflowing with anticipation for the BC.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The passion of the running Umamusume,
and the fervor of the fans cheering them on...
Just watching them sends chills down my spine...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I see... So this is the BC...!
choice_data_list: (To this stage... I have to be the one to guide them...!)
(To this stage... I have to be the one to guide them...!)

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it really is deeply moving.
To think that little Loves-chan has grown to take on such a grand challenge."

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Totally" "So touching"
"Makes me feel like a proud auntie"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Deeply moving...? 
Hehe, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: “Winning that kids' race is what started her streaming career... Back then, she just purely and innocently wanted to run faster and faster.”

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"『Such a rookie vibe?』 『Brings back memories.』
『Both her streams and her running felt so fresh and new back then, didn't they?』"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text: "The thing is... she started saying ambitious things like, 'I'm definitely going to win the tournament with all the kids from the Junior Race Club!'"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"The indescribable emotion I felt
when you confided that you wanted to enter Tracen Academy..."

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: "That's how, step by step, our dreams grew bigger and bigger."

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next up is the BC, huh?’ ‘An unprecedented peak.’
‘Man, this is so deeply moving.’ ‘Do your best, Loves~!’
‘This is way too hype.’"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Together with everyone,
we nurtured our love bit by bit and let our dreams grow big.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to that,
I can now set my sights on the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: At first, I was just happy that there were more things I could do. I vaguely felt glad being praised and cheered on...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to everyone's love, little by little...
I began to have dreams. Wanting to win more, wanting to enter Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "By granting them and returning the love... That's how this love grew. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I want to spread this love even wider!
I want to fill the whole world with love!
I just can't wait for a future like that.

Loves Only You smiles with delight.
A warm love is undeniably shared and blossoming
between her and her fellow members—
choice_data_list: (There's no time to be feeling pressured)

text_block_list.text:
I want to make her dream come true.
No, that is the very reason I am here right now.
In that case... I must fire myself up as well!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: I will lead you to the very top of the BC, no matter what!
I'll definitely lead you to the top of the BC!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: I will lead you to the very top of the BC, no matter what!
I'll definitely lead you to the top of the BC!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh?!" "Well said!"
"You tell 'em, Bridge!"
"That's the spirit! Run straight toward the sunset!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I like that, that's great!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Spontaneous stream! Let's do a stream where we run towards the sunset right now!
We can count it as roadwork, too♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you do your best too, Trainer-kun!
Final stretch! Dash toward that setting sun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you do your best too, Trainer-chan!
Final stretch! Dash towards that sunset!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, bridge!" "This is youth!"
"Loves-chan is wickedly fast, obviously."

—Muscle soreness tomorrow is guaranteed, but...
I could clearly feel our unity growing even stronger heading into the BC.
